name: Cruise (robotaxis)
title: Was Cruise too early? No: Waymo ran rides meanwhile
question: Was Cruise too early for robotaxis?
answer: Cruise, owned by GM, ran driverless rides in San Francisco until a 2023 crash and suspension; in December 2024 GM said it would stop funding robotaxi development. Through the same years Waymo ran paid driverless rides and expanded to more cities. A competitor scaling in the same window means the enabler had crossed.
verdict_reason: Waymo ran and expanded paid driverless service in the same years.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.

winners.name: Waymo
winners.note: paid driverless rides in several US cities
